gap: No result ChatGPT got states how many 8-hour workdays each quiet wireless board runs per charge with its backlight on versus off (Lofree Flow 2 84: about 2 lit and about 11 unlit; NuPhy Air75 V3: about 7.5 to 12.5 lit and about 150 unlit; Kensington MK7500F: about 11 at full backlight).
standout_why: Compared against mkbguide.com (cited), keyboardranker.com (cited) and theofficejournal.com (rank 1), all opened 2026-11-21. mkbguide already prints the raw rated hours and mAh for the Air75 V3, Flow 2 84, MX Mechanical and others, and keyboardranker prints the Kensington and Keychron V6 Max hours; neither converts them to workdays or compares lit against unlit runtime. Theofficejournal gives no battery, dB or price figures. The two cited RTINGS pages (best/quiet, best/work) returned only navigation through every fetch route I tried, so I could not compare against them. The stronger derived figure for this question, the dBA gap between boards, could not be built for the same reason, so what is left is a battery figure that is only partly new and is secondary to quietness.
decides: It does not change the quiet pick; it only qualifies it. On mkbguide's figures the Lofree Flow 2 84 (our linkable row, Void silent switch) needs a charge about every 2 workdays with the backlight on, against about 7.5 to 12.5 for the NuPhy Air75 V3 and about 11 for the Kensington MK7500F. With the backlight off the Flow 2 lasts about 11 workdays, and the wired Cherry KC 200 MX never needs charging. The page can therefore tell an office buyer to run the Flow 2 unlit, and it confirms the Air75 V3 as the lower-maintenance wireless choice.
